name: Dettie Onus Browne
title: Accredited Mental Health Social Worker & Family Therapist
description: I'm Dettie, a white, neurodiverse, non-binary queer and trans person... I have an invested interest in working with neurodivergent people, LGBTIQA+ people and their families, survivors of conversion & suppression practices, people who have used violence in relationships and people who experience complex and/or relational trauma.
specialties: LGBTIQA+, trans, conversion practice survivors, complex trauma, relational trauma, family therapy, neurodivergent
identity: neurodiverse, non-binary queer and trans person

name: Ché Stevenson
title: Counsellor & Psychotherapist
description: Specialisations include working with BIPOC, LGBTIQA+, Gender Non-Binary, CALD, Adoptees and Carers. Areas of interest include Sexuality, Gender Diverse, Sex Work Positive, DV and CPTSD.
specialties: LGBTIQA+, gender non-binary, gender diverse, sexuality, sex work positive, CPTSD, BIPOC

name: Bridie Mills
title: Counsellor & Psychotherapist
description: Bridie has worked within the LGBTIQA+ community, particularly with transgender and gender diverse people. He has also worked as a donor conception counsellor and is experienced in working with those affected by family violence.
specialties: LGBTIQA+, transgender and gender diverse, donor conception, family violence

name: Rae Sabine
title: Psychotherapist, Arts Therapist & Supervisor
description: I'm Rae (they/them) and I'm a trans non-binary and multiple neurodivergent registered supervisor, arts therapist, and psychotherapist with a lived experience of chronic illness. I am very passionate about disability rights, the LGBTQIA+ community and mental health.
specialties: LGBTQIA+, trans, non-binary, arts therapy, neurodivergent, disability

name: Marlee Greer
title: Clinical Counsellor (PACFA)
description: Online therapy across Australia for women, trans, and non-binary adults who are queer or neurodivergent... I'm a queer, AuDHD therapist. Long-term, relational depth therapy; post-graduate training in Somatic Psychotherapy.
specialties: queer, trans and non-binary adults, neurodivergent, late-discovery, depth therapy, somatic

name: Wren Jablonka
title: Counsellor
description: I am a transgender/nonbinary counsellor with a passion for working with fellow community members. I primarily work with adolescents and young adults... anxiety, mood, and neurodiversity.
specialties: transgender, nonbinary, adolescents, young adults, neurodiversity, CBT, ACT

name: Jaz Forrester
title: Clinical Counsellor (PACFA)
description: A Clinical Counsellor offering trauma-informed, gender-affirming, and neuroaffirming support for adults across Australia. I work with people navigating complex trauma, including sexual assault, PTSD, systemic harm, identity exploration.
specialties: complex trauma, sexual assault, PTSD, gender-affirming, neuroaffirming

name: Felix Perigrie
title: Counsellor
description: Felix works with teens and adults on the ADHD and Autistic spectrum, LGBTQIA+ folks, and anyone who has ever felt like they don't fit in. Felix has previously worked as a peer counsellor with LGBTQIA+ folks.
